ticketorder-service
[Container: Spring Boot 4 / Java 21]
REST /api/orders on port 8090
Owns Order aggregate (TicketOrder / OrderItem)
Saga participant via RabbitMQ
JWT auth (jjwt 0.12.6)

ticketwave-events (monolith)
[Container: Spring Boot 4 / Java 21]
REST API on port 8081
Aggregates: Event, Promotion, User, Fraud,
Payment, Ticket, Notification
Saga orchestrator (Order → Payment → Ticket → Notify)
Internal REST (X-Internal-Token) for cross-service
